_note: V5.3 a, the plant-closure rule (docs/design/v5.3-ab.md 3.2, src/sim/closures.gd). STAND-INS written by Systems so the rule can be measured; Content authors the numbers (the spec's section 10), as data, never per firm. window_months: the months over which a major's output fall is measured. fall: the fraction of its output a major must lose over the window to announce a closure (chosen from a measured survey: about one closure a year per playable nation at 0.04). cut: the share of the firm's live share, so of its jobs, a landed closure removes (a plant, not the firm). cooldown_months: the months after a closure ends before the same firm may announce again (at least window + the answer's months, so a landed closure's own cut never re-announces). bloc_offset: what a landed closure moves, per closure.
